title: Classic Hodgkin Lymphoma: Biology-Driven Disease Model.
snippet: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma (cHL) is a unique lymphoid neoplasm in which rare malignant Hodgkin and Reed-Sternberg (HRS) cells orchestrate an extensive, spatially organized immune and inflammatory microenvironment that determines diagnosis, prognosis, and therapeutic sensitivity.
